confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 from general knowledge of Japanese prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine use local beer-price relationships because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is the least certain, since summer demand and business-hotel pricing vary widely. Japanese restaurant bills typically include tax with no service charge, so the midrange figure reflects that. The FX observation comes from an RBA exchange-rates overview excerpt surfaced in search; the full F11 daily table was not opened, and the 16 October figure seen on a third-party site was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a large Japanese regional city, below Tokyo and Osaka tourist districts and close to ordinary mid-sized Japanese city prices. The yen-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 150 JPY per USD.
